build_FrozenInTime_model: build a FrozenInTime model with SpaceTimeTransformer video and RoBERTa text encoders for multimodal learning
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through FrozenInTime with video and text data to get fused embeddings
compute_text_embeddings: compute text embeddings using the RoBERTa encoder and projection head from FrozenInTime
compute_video_embeddings: compute video embeddings using the SpaceTimeTransformer encoder and projection head from FrozenInTime
calculate_similarity_matrix: calculate the cosine similarity matrix between two sets of normalized feature vectors
